title: Validate the design-option count
responsibility: Returns the requested design count and rejects explicit counts outside the Plan rules.

inputs.name: designCount.request
inputs.description: A Plan or Change request with an optional designOptions count. An explicit count is allowed only on Plan and must be an integer from 1 to 10.

outputs.name: designCount
outputs.description: The supplied valid count, or 3 when omitted. The omitted-count default is returned even for Change; this helper does not itself generate designs.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws if a Change explicitly supplies a count, or a Plan count is not a whole number from 1 to 10.
